doc.title: Marty Sheller interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 9, 2022

title: Welcome and introduction
summary: Rowe welcomes Sheller and notes he is still active at the keyboard.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive, and boy am I pleased to have Marty Sheller with me today. Mr. Sheller, welcome, and congratulations on your career.
It’s been a long and fruitful one, and I can see behind you at the keyboard and music placed in various spots, that you’re still at it?
